name: System Monitor
description: Native Linux system monitoring for Mint and other Debian-family desktops.

name: Software
description: Unified Infiltrator software discovery, installation, updates, repositories, history and repair.

name: Files
description: InfiltratorOS file manager with asynchronous browsing, deterministic file operations and an independently installable aggressive CPU-native PGO build.

name: System Settings
description: Native system-wide settings shell and shared policy controls for Infiltrator applications.

name: InfiltratorOS
description: InfiltratorOS desktop integration and native provisioning with one consolidated progress window, serialized native installs, and 60 individually verified jobs including FAT12 and FAT16 shared-object modules.

name: Boot
description: InfiltratorOS UEFI boot manager. Debian-managed firmware files with explicitly confirmed ESP deployment.

name: Calendar
description: Enhanced Cinnamon clock and calendar with multiple time and calendar systems.

name: Slicer
description: 3D-print preparation, model slicing and G-code generation for FFF and resin printers.

name: Defragmenter
description: Direct filesystem analysis and layout optimisation tooling.

name: FAT12
description: Independent FAT12 filesystem release: native CPU-optimised read/write FAT12.so, independently OVMF-qualified FAT12.efi, and Linux 6.12.107-pinned read/write fat12.ko. Firmware/kernel deployment and real-media durability are separately gated.

name: FAT16
description: Independent FAT16 filesystem release: native CPU-optimised read/write FAT16.so, independently OVMF-qualified FAT16.efi, and Linux 6.12.107-pinned read/write fat16.ko. Firmware/kernel deployment and real-media durability are separately gated.

name: FAT32
description: Independent FAT32 filesystem release: native CPU-optimised read/write FAT32.so, independently OVMF-qualified FAT32.efi, and Linux 6.12.107-pinned read/write fat32.ko. Firmware/kernel deployment and real-media durability are separately gated.

name: Filesystems
description: Debian-first manager for discovering, installing, removing, loading and unloading filesystem support.

name: InfiltratorFS
description: Native Format 0.19 filesystem with Linux VFS/DKMS, verified mount-state detection, desktop file-manager opening and recovery tools; physical power-loss durability and native Windows mounting remain in qualification.

name: Calculator
description: Native cross-platform calculator with Standard, Scientific and Programmer modes.

name: MBLink
description: Mercedes-Benz diagnostics and vehicle-data application family.

name: JAGLink
description: Jaguar diagnostics and vehicle-data application family.

name: WHERE'S WALLY
description: Zabbix NPS authentication event monitor and search module.

name: FORDLink
description: Ford diagnostics with a generic Link standards baseline.

name: AUDILink
description: Audi diagnostics with a generic Link standards baseline.

name: BMWLink
description: BMW diagnostics with a generic Link standards baseline.

name: Egypt
description: Native Egyptian city-building and civilisation simulation.

name: RunnerScope
description: GitHub Actions self-hosted runner monitoring, active jobs and local runner service health in the shared Infiltrator console.

name: Intune Zabbix Bridge
description: Microsoft Intune reboot telemetry bridge with native Zabbix Reboot Watch widget. Universal package; deployment credentials are supplied separately.

name: Backyard Racer
description: Native street-rod garage, tuning and racing game.
